set.acceptance: A testscript in a run with journaled rounds: no confirmed finding passes; one confirmed major-kind finding in round 1 or 2 fails and adds nothing; one confirmed in round 3 adds a question node whose statement holds the finding and its reason, linked blocks to the capability it names, journals it with an asked entry per added question, and passes. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestPlanReviewDowngradeByKind shows a confirmed missing-provenance finding and a missing-acceptance one downgraded to minor pass review-check and gateReview, and the missing-acceptance one, once confirmed, fails review-check.
set.statement: rhiza run review-check counts only the latest round's confirmed findings that are still major: a finding's own severity, or the severity a critic downgraded it to, else its kind's (missing-acceptance, contradiction and outside-intent are major; missing-provenance and unreal-depends-on are minor), a confirmed minor or nit never counting. It passes when the latest round has none and fails when it has any in round 1 or 2; after a third round that still has them it adds each as a question node (in the run's change set while it is open, else where review-questions-follow-the-node puts it), linked blocks to the node it names when that is a capability, journals them, and passes, so the plan reaches the gate with those questions open; a confirmed minor-kind finding is never added as a question. It also journals each question it adds as an asked entry, so that in an autonomous run the arbiter decides it. The gate's review check (gateReview) counts the same findings.
